bilingualEducationNotes: Indigenous languages are used in the official and private schools of the comarcas
The recognised languages are Ngäbe, Buglé, Kuna, Emberá, Wounaan, Naso Tjerdi and Bri Bri
A gradual and staged process carries it through all levels and modalities
Implementation is obligatory in official and private schools in all indigenous communities
The implementation plan is to reach more than 132,000 children and young people
